page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX512F, AES, and FMA. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 25% tier, with single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%. However, the 32-vCPU allocation elevates multi-core performance to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core benchmarks. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the middle 50% tier, registering 98.48 GB/sec for large-block read operations.

Given its balanced resource distribution and average multi-core capabilities, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads that benefit from parallel processing rather than high single-thread performance. Appropriate applications include static web serving, multi-threaded decompression tasks, Redis database operations, and moderate software compilation. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio make it a stable choice for steady-state enterprise workloads, though workloads requiring high single-core throughput or local NVMe storage may find better resource density elsewhere.

It is best suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, Redis operations, and moderate software compilation tasks that do not require high single-thread speed.
